description: The Australian income tax brackets for a financial year and residency, as on the paycalculator.com.au income tax page, and optionally the income tax on an amount of taxable income with its marginal and average rates. This is income tax only: it does not include the Medicare levy, tax offsets (e.g. the low income tax offset), student loan repayments or deductions. Use calculate_pay for the tax actually payable on a salary.

income.description: Annual taxable income to work out the income tax on.

residency.description: Residency for tax purposes. "workingHolidayMaker" is for 417/462 visa holders. Defaults to "resident".

year.description: Financial year as the year it ends, e.g. "2027" for 2026-27. Defaults to the current financial year. Use list_tax_years for supported years.

name: tax_rates

rate.description: Tax rate (%) on each dollar in the bracket.

taxBelow.description: Income tax on the income below this bracket.

estimate.description: True when the rates for this year are projected rather than legislated.

averageRate.description: Income tax as a percentage of the income.

incomeTax.description: Income tax on the income, before the Medicare levy and offsets.

marginalRate.description: Tax rate (%) on the next dollar earned.

medicareLevyRate.description: The Medicare levy rate (%) for residents, on top of income tax (reduced or nil at low incomes). 0 for non-residents and working holiday makers.

title: Tax rates
